question: 200 friends each post mostly from their one best week a year. On average, how many friends are in their best week right now?
answer: About 4 friends: every week the feed is stocked with several people at their yearly peak.
move: A feed of highlights from many people is a highlight every day.
ask: When my week feels dull next to my feed, how many of those posts are someone's best moment?
trap: Assuming a friend's peak week is rare, so feeds show ordinary life.
hint: Each friend's best week is one of 52 in the year.
steps: Each friend has 1 best week out of 52
About 4 friends: every week the feed is stocked with several people at their yearly peak.
reference: Leon Festinger, A Theory of Social Comparison Processes, Human Relations, 1954
